detail.longDescription: To program efficiently, I often need to find a clear conceptual idea in my head how to proceed and then see it fail in the real code to find the right way forward. I got reminded of that by a talk about reliability in SQLite with “gotta use your whole brain”: https://www. youtube.com/watch?v=V_qzqY1bb7 I&t=1993s Writing code on paper can sometimes allow skipping the second step when I then go to the computer, when I really know the whole project by heart or work on a strictly delimited task. # programming
